headline: Packaged tools post-process pathway, m6A, radiation transcriptomic, and cell death data
label: Bioinformatics Tools For Omics Analysis
summary: Recent releases package pathway topology, m6A site post-processing, and cell death prioritization into reproducible R and web workflows.
synthesis: The dominant thread is software that packages existing resources and statistical post-processing into reusable workflows for omics and pathway data. WayFindR converts WikiPathways and KEGG pathways into igraph graphs to detect negative feedback loops in biological pathways. m6AnetAnalyzer post-processes site-level m6Anet predictions, summarizing distributions, annotating sites, and quantifying differential methylation. DoReMiTra unifies curated radiation transcriptomics microarray and RNA-seq datasets under harmonized metadata for orchestrated analysis. RCDRank prioritizes 18 regulated cell death modalities by combining seven gene set enrichment tests via Tippett p-value and robust rank aggregation. A withdrawn microbiome random-effects network preprint sits at the edge of this set, and its biological validation of inferred directions remains incomplete. What distinguishes these records is their focus on interpretation layers built atop existing detection methods or curated resources, rather than new primary assays.
